review_notes: I read the whole file. I also checked the TauCeti helpers it uses (`Groupoid.singleObjFunctor` and `Groupoid.functorOfEndHom` in SingleObj.lean). I grepped Mathlib for `PathConnectedSpace.somePath` and for SingleObj/representation correspondences. I found nothing in Mathlib that corresponds to `pathFromBase` (the chosen path classes out of the basepoint, normalized to be the identity at the basepoint). I also found no Mathlib construction of a local system or functor on the fundamental groupoid from a `Representation` of `π₁`. `ofRepresentation` is a thin composite of existing generic pieces, and the file itself explains why it is exposed. Its API is specific to local systems and is not a competing copy of a Mathlib concept. I found no justified finding. The main uncertainty is that I did not exhaustively search Mathlib for every possible overlap with `Groupoid.functorOfEndHom`, which lives in a different file.
